description: Set the phone sign-up form of an app: an extension in the customer's Yemot HaMashiach phone menu (an Israeli phone IVR provider, "yemot") asks the caller questions, by keypad or a voice recording, and every finished call becomes one row on a board of the app. Use it for people without a smartphone who call a number to register for an event, pledge a donation, place an order or report attendance. Replaces the whole form. This provider has no call log, so configure_telephony_mapping and run_telephony_sync do not apply to it. Steps (1 to 12, asked in order): key (letters and digits only, up to 20, unique in the form, must not start with "api" and must not be "hangup"), prompt (Hebrew, up to 300 characters, read aloud to the caller by text to speech), type, columnId (the board column that gets the answer, one column per step, never two steps on one column). Types: digits = any digits such as an ID number, min and max are the fewest and most digits (1 to 30); number = an amount or quantity, written to the column as a number, min and max again count digits; phone = a phone number; choice = one key out of choices, { "1": "text", "2": "text" } (digits 0 to 9, 1 to 10 choices, each text different and up to 60 characters), and the column gets the chosen text, so for a dropdown or status column write the labels exactly as the column's options; record = a voice recording, the column (text) gets a reference to the file in the customer's Yemot system, not the audio. Column types that fit: digits text, phone or number; number number or text; phone phone or text; choice text, dropdown or status; record text. Because the prompts are read aloud, write short plain Hebrew sentences, no symbols or punctuation tricks, and say what to press, e.g. "הקישו את מספר המשתתפים ולסיום סולמית". greeting is said once before the first question (optional); thanks is said after the row is saved (required). callerPhoneColumnId (phone or text) receives the caller's number and callIdColumnId (text) Yemot's call id, both optional and not shared with a step column. savePartialOnHangup: true saves the answers given so far when the caller hangs up halfway. Column ids come from get_board_schema; the board and its columns must be in the app's project. After saving, give the customer the settings from get_telephony_ivr_instructions to paste into the extension. Needs the server to have phone forms on: a 404 means it is not enabled yet. Admin of the app.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

boardId.description: The board that receives a row per finished call

callIdColumnId.description: Text column that gets Yemot's call id

callerPhoneColumnId.description: Column that gets the caller's number

greeting.description: Hebrew text said once before the first question

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

savePartialOnHangup.description: Save the answers so far if the caller hangs up halfway

steps.description: The questions, in the order they are asked

choices.description: choice only: { "1": "text written to the column", ... }, keys are single digits

columnId.description: Column id of the board that gets this answer (from get_board_schema)

key.description: Letters and digits only, unique in the form; not starting with "api", not "hangup"

max.description: digits and number only: most digits

min.description: digits and number only: fewest digits

prompt.description: Hebrew, read aloud by text to speech: a short plain sentence that says what to press

thanks.description: Hebrew text said to the caller after the row is saved

name: set_telephony_ivr_form
